summary: Make this a short, informal evening food crawl at Lang Mor (Kad Lang Mor), the student-oriented street market behind Chiang Mai University along Suthep Road. A current Chiang Mai market guide describes roughly 50 food stalls and a 17:00–21:00 schedule; come early, browse the row, and choose a few freshly cooked snacks or a meal. This is a flexible market visit rather than a curated tasting tour.
whyGo: See a university neighborhood food scene with mostly student-oriented stalls and everyday street food, away from the Old City market circuit.
Pick from a changing row of vendors and try northern Thai and familiar Thai dishes at student-market prices; the atmosphere and selection are the main draw.
bestFor: Independent eaters who like browsing stalls and sharing a few small dishes.
Travelers staying around Nimman or CMU who want a casual evening meal with a local student crowd.
skipIf: You need a quiet, seated, reliably step-free dining experience; a local guide reports limited seating and the market can be crowded.
You need guaranteed vegan, halal, allergy-safe or specific dishes; stall menus and preparation practices vary.
duration: Allow 60–90 minutes for a slow browse, ordering and eating; this is a planning estimate. The market guide lists about 50 stalls along the road, but there is no fixed route or tour.
cost: No admission fee is indicated. Plan roughly THB 150–300 per person for a filling mix of market dishes and a drink; this is a budgeting estimate, not a verified current menu price. Carry small cash and confirm prices before ordering.
hours: A Chiang Mai market guide lists Lang Mor Night Market at 17:00–21:00 daily. Stalls may open or close at different times; treat this as an approximate schedule and confirm locally, especially around holidays.
bestTime: Go around 17:30–19:00 to catch stalls setting up and have time to browse before the listed 21:00 close. Arriving earlier may mean some vendors are not ready; late arrival risks fewer choices.
gettingThere: Search for Lang Mor Night Market / Kad Lang Mor on Suthep Road behind CMU, near Soi 7. From central Nimman, a market guide estimates about a 15-minute Grab ride; traffic varies. A red songthaew may be available toward CMU/Suthep Road, but agree the destination and fare before boarding. Once there, browse on foot; parking and traffic can make driving inconvenient.
booking: No booking or entrance ticket is indicated; this is a self-guided market stop. Stall availability changes by day and season.
accessibility: No formal accessibility information was found. Expect a roadside market with uneven walking surfaces, parked vehicles, crowds and limited seating; step-free access, accessible toilets and quiet space are unconfirmed.
practicalTips: Browse the full row before buying, then share a few items so you can sample more than one stall. Ask what is freshly cooked and whether the dish is spicy.

Many common Thai dishes contain fish sauce, shrimp paste, pork or meat stock. State dietary needs clearly, ask about shared grills and utensils, and do not assume a dish is vegetarian from its appearance.
For allergies, use a translated allergy card and confirm directly with the cook; cross-contact cannot be ruled out at open stalls.
Bring small baht notes, keep valuables secure in the crowd, and arrange your return ride before the market winds down.
decemberNotes: December 2026 vendor lineups, hours and holiday changes are not published in the sources reviewed. The market guide gives a general daily schedule, not a dated December calendar. Cooler evenings are usually more comfortable for an outdoor food crawl, but check the forecast and confirm activity locally during the trip.
uncertainties: The 17:00–21:00 hours and approximately 50-stall description come from a current third-party Chiang Mai market guide, not an official market operator; individual vendor schedules can differ.
Current stall-level prices, menus, dietary practices, seating, toilets and accessibility details could not be verified. The per-person amount is a planning estimate.
No official December 2026 schedule or holiday opening notice was found.
